documented_contract.base_url: Cursor Desktop exposes one global Override OpenAI Base URL and appends /chat/completions; it is not per model or per provider.
documented_contract.model_discovery: Manual Add Model; no authenticated /v1/models synchronization contract is documented.
documented_contract.credential: The API key is stored through Cursor-managed secure UI state. Direct state.vscdb mutation is unsupported.
